facts.variant: AO3400A N-channel; not AO3400 or AO3401A
facts.conditions: The maximum column provides conditioned bounds; typical values are not maxima. Current entries are electrical test points, not recommended load currents. The 125-C row applies to VGS=10 V and ID=5.7 A only: no elevated-temperature maximum at 2.5 V or 4.5 V is invented. Page-3 curves are typical; note E describes their <300-us pulses and <=0.5% duty, not a continuous-load qualification.

facts.conditions: The cover associates its 5.7-A summary with VGS=10 V; the absolute-maximum current rows are not a PCB load recommendation or proof of continuous 5.7-A operation on an arbitrary board. facts.variant: AO3400A N-channel; not AO3400 or AO3401A
facts.conditions: VSD has a maximum only at its stated test point; recovery entries are typical, not worst-case limits. The 2-A diode-current entry does not qualify a board for continuous diode heating or prove an inductive load is protected. The internal diode conducts from S toward D; it is not an automatically adequate flyback path for every external circuit. Actual commutation, dead time, inductance, pulse energy, transient voltage and thermal conditions remain unknown.
